description: Browse MomoSwap NFT launchpad drops: name/symbol, collection mint, phase, minted vs supply, graduation progress, floor price once graduated, royalty and the mint window. Phases: `upcoming` (not open), `live` (minting off the curve; holders can sell back), `sold-out` (waiting to graduate), `minting` (graduated at its target; the rest mint at random by request), `graduated`, `ended` (closed short; holders redeem a refund). Defaults to live drops. Use get_nft_drop for prices. Read-only — no key needed.
name: get_nft_drops
title: List NFT drops
